honesty_rules: Show only what the record holds; a value the record does not hold renders as absent, never synthesized.
Defined-but-not-run experiments render as exactly that.
Weights and scores are read from the code and records at collection time, never transcribed from prose claims.
Workflow run counts are API observations stamped with their read time, not live claims.

data.invariant_note: The minimum viable test cohort covers seven hard invariants. Failed experiments remain evidence and are not automatically rerun merely to improve dashboards.

workflows.name: ATES Orchestrator Benchmark
workflows.role: Deterministic benchmark: on changes to the evaluator, the fixtures or the ATES docs, runs the orchestrator suites and evaluates scripts/ci/evaluate_orchestrator_benchmark.py over the fixtures, asserting the deterministic verdicts (pass case PASS; leak case FAIL_DETERMINISTIC with net_score 0.0).

workflows.name: ATES Phase B Run Receipt
workflows.role: Run receipts: on completion of 'Continuous agent ops', emits a metadata-only receipt (scripts/ci/emit_ates_run_receipt.py — event + run id/attempt; no head_commit, no html_url) and publishes it as a 30-day Actions artifact.

workflows.name: Agent MVT experiment loop
workflows.role: Execution vehicle for the MVT surface's schema-conforming experiments: checks out candidate and baseline refs independently, measures, records.
workflows.discipline: permissions are contents:read only; the workflow header states it NEVER mutates refs — branch switching never becomes history rewriting.

fixtures.label: Synthetic boundary cases for the benchmark suite — fixtures, not recorded experiment results.

data.trace_schema: docs/ops/ATES-ORCHESTRATOR-TRACE.schema.json — validated by the benchmark workflow on every run.

citations.label: MVT — experiment records and practice
citations.note: Experiments the harness executes are recorded in the EXPERIMENT schema and owned by the MVT surface.

citations.label: DoE — first factorial slice
citations.note: The factorial design for ATES-cohort arms is defined in §DoE of the harness doc and owned by the DoE surface.
